attackers_goals: Discover EC2 resources and network setup to find potential weaknesses or targets. Use the gathered information to enable lateral movement, privilege escalation, or data exfiltration.
description: EC2 infrastructure enumeration activity detected within a specific AWS region.
investigative_actions: Identify and review the specific EC2 enumeration API calls executed and their frequency. Verify the identity performing the calls and assess if this behavior is typical or anomalous. Correlate with other discovery activities and check related logs for suspicious patterns or subsequent actions.
name: AWS EC2 infrastructure enumeration activity
